Recorded
1962 on Commons; July 1960 in the DG recital discography. Disputed: sources disagree

Commons’ filename and date field say 1962, with an unsupported 1 January day. The matching DG recital programme is documented as July 1960. The specific digital file has not been compared with the carrier, so the discrepancy is preserved rather than silently corrected.

  • 1962 — Commons attribution; day and month unestablished.
  • July 1960 — DG Piano Recital session.

[5] [6]
Recording rights
Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis). Documented

Commons applies PD-EU-audio and attributes Argerich’s DG recording to 1962. The dossier preserves the competing 1960 recital session and 1961 original-issue attribution; every candidate precedes 1963. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
